items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And he told me, he said, these guys, you probably know who I'm talking about, played him down so low... This guy was the authority on Byrd

ctx.x: And he told me, he said, these guys, you probably know who I'm talking about, played him down so low, he says it just was getting to him, nightly, you know. This guy was getting up, he was the authority on Byrd, and he was the authority on how the Byrd learned to play. And like McShann was just another man in the band.
